raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely committed to Marcello Pagliero as “the” director of Vestire gli ignudi and proceeded to find his death place without first disambiguating the film title. They did not verify whether multiple adaptations with the same title exist (which they themselves noted should be checked), risking answering for the wrong director and thus the wrong death location.
